# Draft:Waraimeshi

|active=2000–|employer=Yoshimoto Kogyo|current_members=}}
is a Japanese comedy duo (kombi) consisting of Koji Nishida (西田幸治) and Tetsuo (哲夫).
They formed in July 2000 and were signed with Yoshimoto Kogyo in 2001 following an audition. They participated in the qualifying round of the 2001 M-1 Grand Prix prior to being signed with Yoshimoto Kogyo, as well as participating in other years until their win in 2010.
Their name means "Laughing Food".
Members
* Tetsuo (哲夫), real name Tetsuo Nakanishi (中西哲夫) Born December 25, 1974 in Nara Prefecture. In charge of writing for comedy routines.
* Koji Nishida (西田幸治) Born May 28, 1974 in Nara Prefecture. Graduated from Yoshimoto NSC Osaka Comedy School in 1995.
They often switch between playing the boke (funny man) and tsukkomi (straight man).
